# docs-clis-mcps-integrations

CLI/MCP integration material — claude-cli, codex-cli, OpenClaw control-ui
gateway. Direct input to the harness/driver contract design.

## Why this matters

OpenClaw control-UI gateway source plus CLI/MCP integration material. The single best place to study what the harness/driver layer needs to abstract over (auth modes, rate limits, install policies, identity, capability detection).

## What lives here

- `agent-vm/archive-openclaw/control-ui/openclaw-control-ui-source/ARCHITECTURE.md` — gateway architecture
- `agent-vm/archive-openclaw/control-ui/openclaw-control-ui-source/gateway-backend/` — TS source for assistant identity, auth-mode policy, rate limits, capability tests
- `agent-vm/archive-openclaw/bin/refresh-openclaw-oauth.sh` — auth refresh
- `agent-vm/archive-openclaw/bin/sync-cli-auth-to-openclaw.sh` — CLI↔gateway auth sync

## Where it connects

- Inspires: harness/driver registry design in `graph/edges/execution.md`
- Adjacent: `lineage-openclaw`, `docs-host-vault-agent-modules-routing`
